subject: DPA: delegation mapping, SCC decision & procurement signoff path
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stratushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@stratushealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA / SCCs / delegation mapping — initial packet and timeline request

Hi Ben / Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Per our procurement checklist attached, our legal team has two priority asks before we can sign the Order Form:

1) Confirm controller/processor roles and delegation map for the proposed architecture (we need explicit subprocessor routing for EU-origin data).
2) Confirm which SCCs variant Redwood proposes to adopt (and whether we'll accept the EU Commission 2021 SCCs or use an alternate addendum).
3) Provide a short evidence bundle and an expected turnaround for final redlines (we're shooting for a counter-signature window by Oct 8).

Attached: Stratus_DPA_Questions.pdf

Can you share an internal owner and proposed timeline? Procurement will need the mutual action plan for their exec review.

Best,
Emily Zhang
Sr. Procurement Manager
Stratus Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DPA / SCCs / delegation mapping — internal coordination

Laura / Olga / Karthik — looping you in to triage Emily's asks from Stratus. Short plan below.

What we need to deliver to Stratus by EOD Thu (9/30):
- Delegation matrix (who is controller vs processor and subprocessor list) — Olga to confirm current subprocessor roster for the regions called out.
- Which SCCs variant we propose (default = 2021 EU SCCs, but we need a fallback note if Stratus requests country-specific clauses).
- DPA redline mark-up and a summary memo highlighting material changes vs our standard DPA.

Olga — can you pull the subprocessor routing export and draft the delegation matrix? I started a draft naming the primary categories (hosting, telemetry, logs, model-training) — attach: DPA_delegation_matrix.xlsx.
Karthik — legal/ops: do we need to route this to compliance for an export-control sign-off? If so, what's the fastest path?

I'll acknowledge Stratus and propose a mutual action plan with dates (we can aim for the Oct 8 sign-by date if legal gets the redline by 10/1).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DPA / SCCs / delegation mapping — delegation matrix + redline

Ben / Laura — attaching initial outputs. Key notes up front:

Attachments: DPA_redline_v1.docx (redline vs Redwood standard DPA), DPA_delegation_matrix.xlsx

Summary:
- Subprocessors: the matrix includes current hosting (GCP-us-west1), telemetry vendor (LogStack Inc.), and embeddings/ML infra (our internal cluster + third-party accelerator ops). All listed with destination regions and encryption at rest status.
- Roles: Redwood remains Processor for customer data ingestion and model inference (consistent with our standard practice). For customers that bring model training datasets, we provide optional training pipelines; those will be documented as "processor-as-service" in the matrix with opt-in checkboxes on the Order Form.
- SCCs: recommendation is to default to EU Commission 2021 SCCs (we include a short fallback paragraph suggesting the use of the UK addendum for UK-only residency requests). If Stratus pushes revisions to the SCCs, highlight the clauses that typically cause negotiation (liability cap carveouts; onward transfer routing).
- Material redlines: 1) liability cap alignment language, 2) audit access cadence, 3) export control notice window (Olga: flagged for Karthik to confirm).

Next steps: legal review of DPA_redline_v1 and I can prepare a version with tracked changes for Stratus if we want to surface the high-impact clauses only.

Olga
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stratushealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@stratushealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DPA / SCCs / delegation mapping — internal coordination

Emily — copying the internal owners. Thanks for the packet. Quick operational notes so procurement has a clear path: 

- Signer path: Redwood proposes standard Order Form signatory (VP of Finance) with legal countersign. If Stratus requires a different signer, we'll accept but it will add a 1–2 business day review.
- DocuSign pre-setup: Ben will send the redline and a prepped DocuSign envelope for the Order Form + DPA (we can attach the redline as an exhibit).
- Timeline:
  * 10/01 — Redwood sends redline + delegation matrix (we will).
  * 10/04 — Stratus returns final redlines / request for call (if needed).
  * 10/06 — Legal exchange & final internal signoffs.
  * 10/08 — Target signature date (aligned with Emily's target).

If procurement needs an earlier cadence for exec review, please flag now and we will compress the timeline.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@stratushealth.com>, procurement@stratushealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DPA / SCCs / delegation mapping — mutual action plan and next steps

Emily / Stratus procurement — thanks again. Attaching the files Olga prepared. Below is the mutual action plan and immediate asks so procurement has a single checklist to pass to the exec committee: 

Attachments: DPA_redline_v1.docx, DPA_delegation_matrix.xlsx

Mutual Action Plan (MAP):
- Redwood to send: delegation matrix + DPA_redline_v1 + short summary memo (today 10/01) — DONE (attached).
- Stratus to return: either (A) signable DPA + Order Form, or (B) a short redline packet (callouts only) by COB 10/04.
- If Stratus requests a walkthrough call, propose Mon 10/05 10:00–11:00 PT; we will block 30/60 minutes depending on the agenda.
- DocuSign: we will prepare an envelope once redlines are agreed; link will be shared in the signing email. Current DocuSign template includes the DPA as an exhibit to the Order Form.

Operational caveats: please note we list LogStack Inc. as a telemetry subprocessor; if Stratus requires removal, that will need a 30-day substitution window and procurement approval (we can add a clause in the Order Form to accommodate). Also, the liability cap language in DPA_redline_v1 is intentionally conservative; legal is open to a triggered escalation if Stratus asks for changes.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8372) — please attach any procurement redline PDFs there so we can track. DocuSign envelope (will be created once redline agreed): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/1234-abcdef

If that all sounds good, Emily — can you confirm the exec review date and whether your legal team prefers a tracked-only redline or a clean DPA with a short memo of changes?

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
